title: Plant expansion brings new jobs to Riverton

claims.why: The state registry lists the 1998 opening.
Current filings put the workforce at about 900, not 1,200.

claims.claim: Dana Reyes said the company never tested the product on animals.

claims.quote: “We never tested this product on animals,” said Orion Labs spokesperson Dana Reyes.

claims.claim: Dana Reyes is a spokesperson for Orion Labs.
